name: Neighborhood Wars
description: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. “Neighborhood Wars” takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

videos.title: Top 10 Showdowns
videos.overview: A look at the Top 10 neighbor confrontations from Season 1 of “Neighborhood Wars”.

videos.title: The Aftermath: Look Who's Back
videos.overview: A man returns from jail, and clashes with the neighbors for the last time. A boundary dispute gets personal, and when a burglary puts a neighborhood on high alert, they witness an even more shocking and violent crime.

videos.title: The Aftermath: Lava Thy Neighbor
videos.overview: An outbuilding is destroyed during a property line dispute, and a neighbor fears for his family's safety. As a volcano erupts, two neighbors have a near-death standoff, and one must face the consequences. And a man is caught littering his neighbor's lawn, then tries to fix it when he thinks no one is looking.

videos.title: See You in Court
videos.overview: Breaking the law has is consequences, and in this top ten episode of Neighborhood Wars, these neighbours took their chances.

videos.title: Fierce Feuds
videos.overview: Sometimes armed, and always a threat, in this top ten special of Neighborhood Wars, these neighbors came prepared to battle.

videos.title: Sweet Revenge
videos.overview: It's payback time in a special look back at the top ten most memorable moments of Neighborhood Wars, and these neighbors came to collect.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: With neighbours like these, who needs enemies? In a special look back at the top ten most memorable feuds of Neighborhood Wars, these neighbours crossed the line.

videos.title: Top 10 Moments of 2023
videos.overview: On this top ten special featuring the most memorable moments of 2023, good neighbors are in short supply.

videos.title: Top 10: United We Stand
videos.overview: Welcome to the softer side of Neighborhood Wars, where neighbors come together to lend a helping hand in this top ten special.

videos.title: Top 10: Family Feud
videos.overview: Rage runs in the family on this top ten special of Neighborhood Wars.

videos.title: Top 10: The Greater Good
videos.overview: Top 10: The Greater Good

videos.title: Top 10: Space Invaders
videos.overview: On this special episode of Neighborhood Wars, there's no place like home...until it's broken into.

videos.title: Top 10: Hometown Heroes
videos.overview: From fighting off bears to high-level rescues, this Neighborhood Wars countdown special proves that not all heroes wear capes and some live right next door. This special features some of the bravest of everyday citizens who refuse to standby in the face of danger.

videos.title: Top 10: Workplace Mayhem
videos.overview: Sparks fly in this special episode of Neighborhood Wars featuring tense moments where the customer may not always be right. Heated confrontations and tense disputes erupt on this top ten countdown causing routine workdays to become all out war.

videos.title: Top 10: Justice Delivered
videos.overview: Average folks dish out a little law and order in this Neighborhood Wars top ten countdown.

videos.title: Top 10: Living Hell
videos.overview: Tenants and landlords tangle big-time in this top ten episode of Neighborhood Wars.

videos.title: Top 10: Battle of the Ages
videos.overview: In this top ten countdown from Neighborhood Wars, sparks fly when kids and adults clash.

videos.title: Top 10: Neighborly Interference
videos.overview: On this special episode of Neighborhood Wars, these neighbors were in the right place at the right time, and did the right thing.

videos.title: Welcome to the Neighborhood
videos.overview: First up, a woman is incensed by her neighbor's parking and takes revenge--on her car! Then, a dog owner allows her pooch to poop on a neighbor's lawn. She doesn't pick up but her neighbor is watching and has a surprise in store. Another young neighbor wants to show off his driving skills but ends up with a serious dent to his pride. And finally a neighborhood hero stops an arsonist in his tracks, saving a grandma and her grandkids and showing us the true meaning of the phrase "love thy neighbor."

videos.title: Love or Loathe Thy Neighbor
videos.overview: A woman films a shocking altercation between her neighbors in their apartment building parking lot which ends in some truly dangerous driving. Then, the stories of a nurse who saved her neighbor's life and a giant firework explosion that rocked an entire neighborhood. Finally, in Pocatello, Idaho the harrowing tale of a young couple's violent neighbor who smashed his way into their apartment with a machete.

videos.title: Good Fences Make Good Neigbors
videos.overview: Next door neighbors go at it over trash cans blocking a parking spot and the street ends up covered with their contents. Another neighbor unleashes an epic rant over the snow shoveled onto his driveway. A city dweller moves to the country, makes friends with his new neighbor only to find out he's not what he seems. And a St. Louis man rushes to save a teenage neighbor who's just been shot right outside his house.

videos.title: Meet the Neighbors!
videos.overview: The residents of one Houston block cower behind locked doors as their terrifying new neighbor--a Bengal tiger--makes a surprise appearance on their front lawns. Then, two New England neighbors put on a potty-mouthed pantomime in the middle of their street. A man looks on in disbelief as his neighbor performs a death-defying rescue attempt on a high-rise ledge. And finally, a couple catch a young neighbor breaking into their car and then deliver a heartfelt life-lesson on what it truly means to respect your neighbors and yourself.

videos.title: Neighbor vs. Neighbor
videos.overview: A man with a baseball bat thwarts thieves from stripping his neighbor's car of valuable parts. Then, in Hawaii, the incredible story of a resident who first loses his home to a volcano eruption and then has his life threatened at gunpoint by a neighbor. Later, neighbors invent the most bizarre and clever ways to share beers during lockdown. And finally, a woman and her young daughter are horrified to discover intruders in their home--and then find out that they're staying next door!

videos.title: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood!
videos.overview: A commuter is given a neighborly greeting he'll never forget as a neighbor's car smashes into his own vehicle, narrowly avoiding a deadly disaster. In Florida, a family discovers one wild neighbor--a huge alligator--taking a dip in their pool. And a New Jersey man proves what it really means to be a good neighbor when he jumps in to save one from a vicious dog attack.

videos.title: Know Your Neighbors
videos.overview: In a scene straight out of a horror movie, an Oregon man is creeped out to discover a neighbor's hand repeatedly reaching under his fence. A student in New Hampshire learns a valuable life lesson when he gets into a scuffle with a neighbor who turns out to be armed. And a Virginia man drunkenly revs his muscle car, waking up neighbors and setting their communal parking lot on fire.

videos.title: Neighbors Know No Boundaries
videos.overview: In a shocking incident, a terrified woman has to run to a neighbor for help after another neighbor breaks into her apartment. In New York, one unfriendly neighbor has a mouth as tough as the city's streets. And following a devastating tornado that has ripped their houses apart, a group of neighbors come together to help each other out.

videos.title: There Goes the Neighborhood
videos.overview: In Salt Lake City, a young woman wakes up to find her next-door neighbor has vandalized her car. When a porch pirate tries to purloin a package, she gets nabbed by the nanny. A Good Samaritan tries to rescue a neighbor who is left hanging from the roof, and in Los Angeles, a food delivery man has to deal with a customer's nasty neighbor.

videos.title: Home Sweet Home or Battlezone?
videos.overview: A man in Washington State tries to solve a long running property-line dispute by destroying his neighbor's building. When a Fourth of July fireworks celebration goes bad, a whole neighborhood has to run for cover. A brave Californian teenager leaps into action to protect her property and a father in Massachusetts finds a new way to lay down the law on his daughter's date.

videos.title: The Nightmare Next Door
videos.overview: Two neighbors have been feuding over access to a boat ramp and it has now reached a boiling point. In an incredible act of bravery, a man pulls an elderly neighbor out of a raging house fire. And an armed face-off between neighbors in Texas has tragic consequences.

videos.title: Battle on the Block
videos.overview: A 25-year-old feud over a shed finally comes to head when one neighbor decides to demolish it with his truck. A neighborhood block party goes disastrously wrong when a hoard of fireworks suddenly explodes, launching burning hot missiles into the crowd. And a Denver man tries to retrieve his neighbor's stolen mountain bike--only to enrage the thief and find himself the victim of a hit and run.

videos.title: Don't You Be My Neighbor
videos.overview: A Maryland woman allegedly sets her home on fire while a neighbor is inside, sitting in a lawn chair to watch it burn. In Phoenix, a man calls for backup from his friends after arguing with his neighbor over car noise. And when a Florida neighborhood is threatened by an angry alligator, a hero with a recycling bin steps in to save the day.

videos.title: No Shirt, No Shorts, No Problem
videos.overview: Shirts come off and the fists fly in Plattsburgh, New York when best friends and neighbors become sworn enemies. A Bothell, Washington, porch pirate receives an instant dose of karma while making her getaway across wet grass. And an officer in Madison, Wisconsin, gets the surprise of his life when he pulls over a self-proclaimed superhero in a thong.

videos.title: Stray Cats, Wild Neighbor
videos.overview: An Arizona man and his family endure years of intimidation from one of their neighbors. A disagreement over the feeding of neighborhood stray cats leads to gunshots being fired into a neighbor's apartment. And an infant dangling from a high-rise balcony spurs a neighbor to attempt a daredevil rescue.

videos.title: Pardon My French Drain
videos.overview: In an Irvine, California apartment complex, a woman bashes her neighbor's door with a dumbbell. Across the country in Philadelphia, a late-night load of laundry enrages a neighbor trying to sleep. And in Florida, a neighbor takes exception to workers stepping over the property line to install a French drain.

videos.title: Bully on the Block
videos.overview: In Florida, a man is unjustly accused of being an outsider when he tries to use the community trash cans. Chaotic street scenes ensure when two old-timers in Philadelphia clash over the same disabled parking spot. And a high school soccer player tackles a neighborhood package thief.

videos.title: Dissing the Downstairs Neighbor
videos.overview: A family's Easter celebration is shattered by neighbors hurling insults. A community comes together after a woman is witnessed mistreating kittens. And when Washington neighbors battle over a parking space, one man retaliates in the only way he knows how--by writing a diss track.

videos.title: Shock and Aww
videos.overview: Pennsylvania landlords get the shock of their lives when their next-door tenant moves out. In Brooklyn, NY, a stolen school bus smashes up the block as the driver tries to escape from the cops. And in Cincinnati Ohio, a Halloween prank requires a neighbor's help to deflate the problem.

videos.title: That's Not Amore
videos.overview: Pizza workers in Brooklyn, NY serve up punches and headlocks when a neighbor starts a late-night brawl. A man tries to blow up his Baltimore County neighborhood before setting fire to his own home. And a Pittsburgh woman takes a shovel to her neighbor's car because it's parked in her husband's usual spot.

videos.title: Ready Neighbor One
videos.overview: In Longview, Washington, a professional video gamer is burglarized after being arrested for a noise complaint--only to realize he's been played by his neighbor. In Denver, Colorado, a scaffolding worker watches a dramatic police chase unfold four stories below him. And in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a man makes an appalling discovery about his neighbor after hearing his dog yelp in the yard.

videos.title: Ding Dong, I'm Divorcing You
videos.overview: A Texas woman is left reeling when a doorbell camera captures her husband's cheating ways. A property line dispute in New Jersey pits a new home owner against a neighbor who runs caution tape between their homes and performs a madcap dance. And a snowball fight between neighbors in Seattle unleashes an alarming chain of events.

videos.title: Grab and Smash
videos.overview: A Las Vegas homeowner throws herself between her pet and a neighbor's vicious dog. The peace of a Los Angeles neighborhood is shattered by a runaway motorhome. And a father vows to bring the culprits to justice when he discovers his daughter's jack-o-lanterns smashed to pieces.

videos.title: Double Trouble Neighbors
videos.overview: When twins in Colorado turn on their neighbors, it spells double trouble. In California, an HOA board member accuses kids on bikes of terrorizing the neighborhood at impossible speeds. And in Carrollton Texas, a noise complaint sees cops busting moves instead of making arrests.

videos.title: Revenge in Reverse
videos.overview: In Pasco County, Florida, a neighborhood feud gets out of hand when a man intentionally backs his car into his neighbor's kitchen. A San Jose family's Christmas is almost ruined when a neighborhood thief makes off with their nativity set. And in Boulder, Colorado, a musician serenades his "foxy" neighbor on his banjo.

videos.title: Manager Meltdown
videos.overview: A store manager makes a stink when he catches two local girls attempting to shoplift air freshener. A couple in Tulsa, Oklahoma, endure countless disruptions from the family next door who they label "the worst neighbors in the world". And in Massachusetts, a burglar makes a desperate bid to flee the cops by jumping through a second-floor window.

videos.title: Stranger Danger
videos.overview: A new black employee at a luxury condo building in Nashville, Tennessee, is confronted by two white neighbors who wrongly accuse him of being up to no good. In Bowie, Maryland, a woman hides in terror after a stranger follows her home. And a resourceful cop in Columbus, Ohio attempts to settle an ongoing dispute between irate neighbors.

videos.title: Pastry Punch Up
videos.overview: Two neighbors slug it out over stolen toaster tarts. A peaceful California neighborhood corner is wrecked when semi-truck drivers get lost. And the theft of valuable puppies leads to a wild shootout in Florida.

videos.title: Good Fences, Bad Neighbors
videos.overview: Two men in Greenwood, Indiana, take aim at each other over the fence when a longstanding feud takes a potentially deadly turn. In Los Angeles, California, residents are locked in a battle of wills with a neighbor who is blocking their shared driveway for no apparent reason. And in Duluth, Minnesota, a man splatters neighbors with paint for stealing his lawn signs.

videos.title: Lobster Roll Wrecker
videos.overview: A neighbor's noise complaint is a terrifying experience for a New York couple. In California, a neighbor sees red when she catches two guys cooking lobster on private property. And in New Jersey, a woman is shocked when neighbors drag up secrets from her past and use them to taunt her and her family.

videos.title: Sunset Flip Out
videos.overview: An Arkansas woman is creeped out when her neighbor installs a gate in his fence that opens directly onto her backyard. In California, a poolside confrontation between neighbors takes an unexpected twist. And, a teacher's loud and elaborate efforts to engage his online students risks angering the neighbors.

videos.title: Not in My Backyard
videos.overview: In Florida, a neighbor and a teenager go head-to-head over a near miss with a hoverboard. A dispute over a political candidate's campaign sign pits New Jersey neighbors against each other. And when a neighbor vandalizes a street corner fruit stand in Los Angeles, it sparks a neighborhood rift with a surprising outcome.

videos.title: The Best Revenge
videos.overview: A woman discovers a neighbor is throwing dog poop on her driveway and plots a cunning revenge. A Delaware organic gardener sets up cameras to catch who is destroying his crops. And an artist in Missouri comes to the defense of two young girls in their neighborhood park.

videos.title: Houseguests From Hell
videos.overview: A Floridian fisherman turns the tables on a territorial neighbor. In Tennessee, a property line dispute makes a neighbor fear for her life. And a couple in Atlanta return to their home after renting it out for the weekend and are horrified by what they discover.

videos.title: Two Full Moons
videos.overview: On a full moon in Illinois, a stranger sets up an erotic photoshoot on a neighbor's porch. Two Florida landscapers are shocked when a woman begins hurling insults. And in Baltimore, a tenant becomes incensed by his landlord's unannounced visits and so decides to lock her out.

videos.title: Can't Contain Your Neighbors
videos.overview: A newly-married couple face a hostile neighborhood when building a tiny home in Missouri out of shipping containers. Brawling neighbors in a New York bodega leaves one with a broken jaw. And in Alabama, a man claims the neighbors stole his dog.

videos.title: Do You Want Her Arrested?
videos.overview: A pedestrian in Chicago loses her cool when one of her neighbors bicycles on the sidewalk. In South Carolina, a man challenges a neighbor for using a handicapped parking spot when she doesn't look handicapped. And an Atlantic City neighbor breaks up a fight between two teenage boys with a lesson in respect.

videos.title: Stay the Hell Off My Property
videos.overview: An Idaho family's next-door neighbor goes to battle with them over the height of their lawn. In Florida, authorities carrying out a home eviction realize they are at the wrong address. And a Kansas neighborhood park is terrorized by two loose dogs.

videos.title: Nothing Good Ever Happens After 2am
videos.overview: A late-night reveler shows up unannounced to a house party and gets a rude welcome. In Scottsdale, Arizona, a barefoot woman blocks the car of two men she accuses of trespassing in the neighborhood. And, when a Kentucky couple's gay pride flag is deliberately set on fight, the neighbors rally around to show their support.

videos.title: Misadventures in Babysitting
videos.overview: The constant beeping of a painter's lift drives a Colorado neighbor to distraction, as he threatens to sever the hydraulic cables with bolt cutter. In Georgia, a neighbor calls the police on a Black babysitter, riding with two white kids in his car, claiming: "I just had a funny feeling". And a neighborhood brawl breaks out on a California beach after a group of women accuse a man of recording them with his phone.

videos.title: Next Door Satanist
videos.overview: A Florida neighborhood meeting is disrupted by a protestor praying to Satan. Neighbors take exception to a remote-controlled car with a camera snooping along their sidewalks. And a backyard gender-reveal party in Philadelphia is so surprising it has neighbors running for their lives.

videos.title: Neighbors and Axes and Knives Oh My!
videos.overview: Neighbors in rural Texas are embroiled in a decades-long feud with daily yelling matches over the fence. A Utah man wildly swings an ax at a group of teens who have gotten on his nerves. And in Florida, an argument over a tree has a neighbor feeling the blunt end of a kitchen knife on the back of the head.

videos.title: Sparks Fly on the Fourth of July
videos.overview: A Florida man takes exception to his neighbor setting off July Fourth fireworks. A couple from Boise, Idaho, catch their neighbor throwing cat litter over the fence. And, in Oakland, California, a man armed with a machete takes some late-night swings at neighborhood traffic.

videos.title: The Big UN-easy
videos.overview: A New Orleans man trims branches off his neighbors' hedge so he can park his car in the street, sparking their fury; neighbors in California take exception to workers climbing over their fence to fix a blocked sewer pipe.

videos.title: Showdown in Swim Shorts
videos.overview: A California woman treats neighbors to breakfast and a show after an apparent discrepancy in paying her restaurant bill; dueling dads come to blows at the neighborhood pool in Texas; a gardener traps her hand in a hedge trimmer.

videos.title: Elevator Screamer
videos.overview: A neighbor pushes a 12-year-old for riding his bike on the sidewalk in Santa Ana, California. One woman's dream of a secluded life in rural Kentucky turns sour when neighbors lay claim to a strip of her land. And a mom home alone in Portland, Oregon, makes a shocking discovery when she finds a stranger sleeping in her bed.

videos.title: Get Off the Sidewalk
videos.overview: In Twin Creeks, Indiana, two couples take on the neighbor who is making their lives a misery. An Arizona family wakes in horror to discover an intruder in their home. And when the resident of an apartment building objects to a contractor using the elevator, she creates an ear-piercing commotion.

videos.title: Unapologetic!
videos.overview: A Texas father is accused of speeding on the street and comes face to face with a neighbor's gun; a New Orleans man gets mad when a block party blocks in his car.

videos.title: Trouble at the End of the Rainbow
videos.overview: A young man turns up on his neighbor's doorstep holding a whip; a dispute in a parking lot becomes violent when a neighbor intervenes; one man's dream of painting his home in rainbow colors sparks a scary backlash in the neighborhood.

videos.title: Grandma Traps a Scammer
videos.overview: An Atlanta woman keeps her entire neighborhood awake as she throws out her cheating boyfriend and all his belongings; a swindler in Long Island, N.Y., learns to never mess with Grandma.

videos.title: The Squeals on the Bus
videos.overview: Angry parents descend on a parked school bus when the driver refuses to let off the children; a quiet neighborhood goes to war with a noisy birthday parade; a kayaker uses a paddle to defend himself from a belligerent neighbor.

videos.title: The Whack Job
videos.overview: A gardener accidentally weed-whacks the neighbor's flowers and faces swift retaliation; a young woman is tormented by her next-door neighbor after spurning his romantic advances.

videos.title: My Neighbor Is Eating My Mail
videos.overview: An Austin, Texas, homeowner is shocked to find a neighbor naked on his lawn, munching his mail. In North Carolina, a package thief is caught on camera shadowing a delivery truck in her car before stealing their drop offs. And a multiplex devolves into uproar when a neighbor checks his phone during the movie.

videos.title: The Axman Cometh
videos.overview: In Illinois, an angry man beats on his neighbor's front door with an ax; a Utah couple confront their neighbor who constantly revs his cars engine in the middle of the night; in Ohio neighbor accuses a man of speeding down their Street.

videos.title: The Almost Naked Gun
videos.overview: Two bikers in Missouri are exploring an abandoned building when an angry neighbour appears and calls the police on them; an armed and nearly-naked Seattle man defends his neighbour's property from thieves.

videos.title: Party Animal
videos.overview: A fight between neighbors in Massachusetts turns shocking when one of the men gets behind the wheel of his SUV; a North Carolina couple running a rescue home for pot-bellied pigs contends with a "party animal" neighbor.

videos.title: In Case of Neighbors: Break Glass
videos.overview: A Los Angeles couple are accused of stomping around their apartment by their downstairs neighbors who demand that they tiptoe instead; A base jumper gets his parachute twisted and gives new meaning to the term "dropping in on a neighbor"

videos.title: Stay Away from My Husband
videos.overview: A woman in Astoria, Ore., battles an angry neighbor who, she claims, takes offense at a bumper sticker on her car; in Plano, Texas, the losing coach of a kids' baseball game gets into a brawl with a parent from the opposing team.

videos.title: My Way or the Driveway
videos.overview: In Romana, Calif., a glossy car photoshoot is disrupted by the protests of a driver in an SUV who claims the crew is shooting on his driveway; a homeowner returns from work to find his house trashed and a neighbor asleep in the bedroom.

videos.title: Not in My Trash Can
videos.overview: An ill-tempered man in Tennessee claims his neighbor's new landscaping is causing flooding in his backyard; in California, a neighbor is alarmed when two strangers come looking for a stolen e-bike in the apartment opposite.

videos.title: Quit Videotaping Me
videos.overview: A neighbor feud turns nasty when the woman next door takes a hammer to an Illinois family's security camera. Neighbors are aghast at the sight of two men taking swings at each other with machetes. And an Atlanta woman accuses a delivery driver of stealing her necklace.

videos.title: The Parent Slap
videos.overview: In Georgia, a parent slaps the school bus driver after the driver refuses to let her kids off the bus. A horrified woman returns to her parked car to find that a neighbor has covered it in steaming dog poop. And uproar erupts at the weigh-in of an Ohio fishing tournament when the prize-winning anglers are accused of stuffing their catch with weights.

videos.title: You're Freaking Me Out
videos.overview: A muscle man's meltdown outside a Southern California gym tests the friendship of two neighbors. A Chicago woman confronts an 11-year-old neighbor who she believes has a gun. And a woman in San Antonio tries desperately to prevent dogs from being abandoned in her neighborhood.

videos.title: Dumped and Doing Donuts
videos.overview: A very public breakup plays out in front of all the neighbors at a Florida apartment complex. Neighbors in upstate New York bicker over temporary snow fencing. And a mail courier in Houston stands his ground in a street fight.

videos.title: Off of Our Grass
videos.overview: A teenager in Washington is harangued by a neighbor when he cuts across the man's lawn. Two women get into a sidewalk standoff in North Carolina when neither will move out of each other's way. And a man defends his neighborhood by fending off suspected car thieves dressed only in his underwear.

videos.title: Girl, You Better Back Up
videos.overview: A Utah woman and her neighbor argue over the building's heating. A Brooklyn landlord's boyfriend breaks through a tenant's door with an ax. And neighbors in rural Nebraska squabble over the property line dividing their homes.

videos.title: Living the American Nightmare
videos.overview: When a skateboarder dodges a young child playing in a Louisiana skate park, he takes out his frustrations on the kid's parents. A neighborhood firework display causes sparks to fly between two neighbors in Orlando. And in Minnesota after a snowstorm, a neighbor accuses a woman of blocking the walkway with her car.

videos.title: Trash Talk
videos.overview: An Illinois man accuses his neighbor of putting garbage in their shared apartment hallway. In Texas, neighbors scuffle apparently over the best spots to view a Fourth of July parade. And in Jacksonville, Florida, a brave sheriff's officer--who can't swim--charges into a lake after a drowning toddler.

videos.title: You Know No One Likes You
videos.overview: A child drops a candy wrapper outside a home in Tennessee, a neighbor's reaction leads to heated words; hundreds of teenagers party in an Arizona garage; in Alabama, a woman is upset by trash outside her apartment complex.

videos.title: Who Stole My Pickleball
videos.overview: Accusations fly in a California neighborhood when pickleball equipment goes missing; neighbors in New York City throw eggs at a man for his extreme views; a homeowner wades through his options as his apartment slowly fills with water.

videos.title: It's All Downhill From Here
videos.overview: A San Francisco man blows his lid when some neighbors don't park properly on a steep hill. In Denver, a dog trainer claims her unwelcome puppy advice ends a friendship with the woman opposite. And in Virginia, neighbors engage in a shouting match, supposedly over late-night noise.

videos.title: The Fourth of You-Lie
videos.overview: When a Houston family is denied access to a Fourth of July party at the neighborhood pool, verbal fireworks are set off. In New York, a man pulls out a switchblade during a school PTA meeting. And in Pennsylvania, a woman taunts her neighbor on her doorbell camera.

videos.title: Next Door Stingers
videos.overview: An East London woman battles a swarm of her neighbor's bees taking over her bedroom. In Texas, a new mother is shocked to witness her neighbor playing with fire. And a Georgia farmer temporarily blocks a school bus after he claims one of the students flips him the bird.

videos.title: Actions Have Consequences
videos.overview: A St. Louis family is alarmed when a neighbor bangs on their door with a hammer. When their leaf blower disappears, two sisters in Virginia decide to confront the neighbors. And in a small Missouri town, authorities enlist the help of a homeowner to reveal the unusual hiding spot of a missing suspect.

videos.title: Survey Says . . . Fight!
videos.overview: Battling neighbors in San Antonio compare land surveys to determine whose yard owns an extra foot of land. A group of Florida college students are confronted by a man with a weapon when trying to ride the elevator. And a Houston woman confronts her online critic at the neighborhood coffee shop.

videos.title: Weeding & Warring
videos.overview: In Sacramento, a neighbor mistakenly believes two women exchanging hair products in the park are actually selling drugs. A belligerent woman smashes her neighbor's window in Virginia. And two neighbors in Canada clash about the lawn care specialist working next door.

videos.title: Don't Put Your Hands on Me
videos.overview: Two Texas neighbors engage in a fiery debate about where dogs should relieve themselves. Next door neighbors in England are embroiled in a relentless battle allegedly over noise disturbances. And when a California woman accuses a landlord of blocking in her car, a scuffle ensues.

videos.title: Sucked into a Tornado
videos.overview: Neighbors in Dayton, Ohio quarrel after construction nails apparently litter a yard where children play. In Olympia, Washington, a couple is awoken by the sound of a neighbor playing basketball against their garage door. And in Little Rock, Arkansas, a woman watching a tornado suddenly finds it spinning towards her.

videos.title: The Grill Sergeant
videos.overview: An Illinois man is threatened by his landlord's son over a lease dispute. In an Oakland, California park, two women have a blazing argument over the right to cook on a charcoal grill. And in Alexandria, Virginia, a neighbor loses his temper over parking.

videos.title: Gone to the Dogs
videos.overview: When two brothers tick off a group of Alabama golfers, their afternoon on the back nine is no laughing matter. In Wichita, Kansas, a neighbor loses his temper over some barking dogs. And in Indiana, a homeowner armed with a flamethrower tackles a threat to his family.

videos.title: How Mean I Can Be
videos.overview: A South Pasadena woman becomes enraged when a film crew shoots a commercial on her street. A dispute over dogs between neighboring residents in Indiana sparks a feud with an unexpected twist. And a minor disagreement over a seat on the New York City subway spirals out of control as two neighbors hurl verbal jabs and insults.

videos.title: Knock It Off, Neighbor!
videos.overview: A couple in Florida are terrified when their neighbor repeatedly bangs on their apartment door looking for a missing bike. A Florida man deals with a trespasser by punching him in the face. And an allegedly stolen yacht crashes into a dock full of neighbors' boats.

videos.title: No Smoke Without Gunfire
videos.overview: A Washington man upset with his neighbors for burning wood in their backyard shockingly turns into a shootout. A Florida woman wrestles with an aggressive neighbor trying to force her way into her apartment. And an escaped emu runs amok in Ohio.

videos.title: All Bark
videos.overview: An elderly New York couple finds themselves in the middle of a dispute with their neighbors over a light in front of their house. In Nashville, two neighbors face off about a fence placed over their shared property line. And in Illinois, a woman proves to be all bark when she confronts her neighbors over an off-leash dog.

videos.title: Garbage Grudge
videos.overview: A neighbor in Arizona creates a stink in an ongoing dispute over trash collection' in South Carolina, a woman goes to battle with her neighbors over her passion for protecting wild geese in her neighborhood.

videos.title: Cat Pervert!
videos.overview: A Florida woman finds herself in hot water with a fellow resident in her building when she soaks in the hot tub after dark; Two neighbors in California go head-to-head over newly-installed security cameras.

videos.title: Game of Cones
